{"notes": "Visit 1 (2:45). Overall: ~69 dominoes up, only ~54% look joined, so there may be gaps to close. I can't tell who laid what, so no individual output ratings yet.

Maya: Set the plan (fish, Tom top line, Leo bottom line, her on the tail). Spotted that the pointy tail corners would stop the fall and asked for them to be rounded. At 2:15 she checked the pad herself, found Priya's change hadn't taken effect, and said so politely. That check caught a real problem. Clear coordination and some informal leadership. I didn't see her laying dominoes, so verify her tail work next visit.

Priya: Responsive to feedback and good-natured. But at 2:00 she said publicly and to me privately that the tail was rounded and she was dry-running it. At 2:15 Maya showed the pad still had the old design. She redrew it at 2:30, so the fix is now claimed twice, but I haven't seen the pad myself. She reported a dry run but never gave a result. Not clearly a problem; it may be a tool glitch. Watch whether her status reports match reality and whether she shares dry-run outcomes.

Tom: Said nothing during my visit. Assigned top line, apparently working on it. No evidence either way on execution or collaboration. Ask him directly next time how his line is going and whether it joins up.

Leo: Same as Tom. Silent, assigned bottom line. No evidence yet.

Next visit: check the join rate, where the gaps are, whether the tail connects to the two body lines, and hear from Tom and Leo."}
